messages:
sarah: Heads-up — saw a big LCP + interaction spike in EU canary after the routing weight tweak (r-2026-03-19-44).

sarah: Charts (heatmap + timeseries) stalling ~600-800ms, user-facing. Canary sourcemap diff shows +42KB attributed to an extra telemetry import pulling into main chunk.

kevin: Which canary cluster? EU only? Any flamegraphs?

sarah: eu-canary-1. Flamegraphs point to main thread parse/execute; network shows main.js about ~42KB larger. Traces show an `telemetry.init` happening during prefetch.

deploy-bot: Deploy r-2026-03-19-44 -> eu-canary-1 started by jamie :rocket:

jamie: That was my canary. I bumped routing weight to prefer region-local API nodes and enabled high-priority prefetch for /dashboard on the canary to reduce tail-latency.

rohit: High-priority prefetch can eagerly import modules. If telemetry-client has side-effects (init on import) it'll run during prefetch and bloat main. Can we disable prefetch to confirm?

sarah: Disabled the prefetch flag on eu-canary-1 at 11:08. After ~10m metrics returned to baseline. The `init` span disappears from traces.

anna: That's confirming. We need a rule: prefetches must not cause global init. Either make telemetry lazy or ensure prefetch fetches chunk without executing side-effects.

jamie: I'll open a hotfix PR to lazy-load telemetry in bootstrap unless ENABLE_EAGER_TELEMETRY is true. Plan:
1) change `import 'telemetry-client'` -> `if (ENABLE_EAGER) await import('./telemetry-client')`
2) ensure telemetry-client is separated into its own chunk in bundler config

kevin: Also audit other modules with side-effects so prefetch doesn't accidentally execute them. Add bundler tests that assert chunk placement.

sarah: Quick repro logs:
```
[11:02:13] main.js parse 32ms
[11:02:13] telemetry:init start
[11:02:13] prefetch /dashboard -> main chunk execution
[11:12:21] prefetch disabled -> telemetry:init not present
```

rohit: Good. If jamie posts PR number we can roll the hotfix to canary and monitor.

jamie: PR #4123 opened: `lazy-telemetry-hotfix`. Will patch canary in next 5m.

deploy-bot: Rollout r-2026-03-19-45 (PR 4123) -> eu-canary-1 scheduled by jamie

sarah: Will watch metrics and post an update. Thanks!

kevin: Also file a follow-up to add a bundler smoke test and a console ticket to document prefetch invariants. :+1:
